ideas.pitch: An augmented reality medical learning tool that overlays interactive 3D skeletal and organ models onto physical textbooks using marker-based tracking.
ideas.title: AnatomyAR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the education and healthcare domain explicitly highlighted in the hackathon description, leveraging practical AR visualization for real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: A mixed-reality campus or museum tour guide application built for Meta Quest headsets that recreates historical artifacts and environments in 3D space.
ideas.title: XRPath
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the tourism and education sectors with an immersive VR experience that demonstrates how spatial computing can transform traditional physical site visits.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision-driven workout trainer that tracks real-time skeletal joints using MediaPipe and renders a 3D avatar mirror in a virtual gym environment.
ideas.title: PoseFit XR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced machine learning pose estimation with interactive 3D graphics, showing a working live demo that judges can interact with instantly.

ideas.pitch: An immersive VR experience where users talk via voice to AI-driven non-player characters that inhabit a virtual workspace to train users in public speaking.
ideas.title: SpatialChat NPC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a real-world professional training problem by fusing generative AI voice pipelines with spatial VR environments for a polished, functional demo.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative virtual reality simulation that visualizes real-time climate data and industrial carbon emissions as an interactive 3D city landscape.
ideas.title: EcoSim VR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles industrial sustainability and real-world impact by translating complex data science metrics into an intuitive immersive XR environment.
